name: TC-11-purchasing-pr-po
description: TC-11: Purchasing Workflow — Purchase Request and Purchase Order creation

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.1 — Purchase Request List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Purchasing → Purchase Request. Purchase requests initiate procurement for materials, spare parts, and services needed for maintenance.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.1 — New Purchase Request
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a purchase request. Specify the requestor, due date, site, and department. Add line items with quantities and unit prices.

steps.value: E2E Test — Spare parts for pump maintenance

doc_metadata.title: TC-11 — Fill Pr Description
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Test — Spare parts for pump maintena" into the Pr Description field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.1 — PR Created (Draft)
doc_metadata.caption: The purchase request is created with an auto-generated ID (e.g., PR-00001) in 'Draft' state. Add line items, then submit for approval.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.1 — Purchase Request Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The purchase request detail shows requestor, due date, and line items. The PR Lines child table allows adding items with quantities, unit prices, and calculated line totals.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the PR with line items section.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.2 — Purchase Order List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Purchasing → Purchase Order. Purchase orders are issued to vendors based on approved purchase requests. PO types include Standard, Blanket, and Contract.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.2 — New Purchase Order
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a purchase order. Select the vendor, PO type, site, and department. Add line items matching the approved PR.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.2 — PO New Form
doc_metadata.caption: The new purchase order form shows fields for vendor, PO type, site, department, and financial details. Select a vendor to link the PO to approved purchase requests.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the blank PO form with all field groups.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.2 — PO Created (Draft)
doc_metadata.caption: The purchase order is created with an auto-generated ID (e.g., PO-00001) in 'Draft' state. The form is editable in Draft. After approval, the form becomes read-only.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the PO with editable fields in Draft state.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.2 — Purchase Order Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The purchase order detail shows vendor, PO type, terms, and line items. Supported PO types: Standard (one-time), Blanket (spending limit), and Contract (date range). The workflow moves through Draft → Open → Closed.
